data.description: Round 3.9 Part 1.8 Item 1: 24 Round 3.8 bullets + 10 held-out controls run through modes A/B/C/D

modeDefinitions.A: Heuristic only: extractVerifiableEntities checks numbers/entities in combined source. No LLM call.
modeDefinitions.B: LLM entailment only: skip entity/number heuristic, rely only on YES/NO LLM claim check. UNVERIFIED — no live model in this run.
modeDefinitions.C: Both (production): heuristic + LLM entailment. Without live LLM client this run produces same as A.
modeDefinitions.D: Evidence-bound: every verifiable term from extractVerifiableEntities must be found as exact substring (or bilingual alias) in the cited chunk text.

bullets.bullet: Artificial intelligence embeds human‑like intelligence into machines to perform tasks autonomously
Functions are compiled from algorithms that enable perception, decision‑making, and action
AI powers smartphones, cars, social‑media feeds, video games, and banking services
Its impact is visible across multiple facets of modern daily life
Robot evaluates lighting and landscape variations to maintain expected performance
Chooses firm or rocky path based on real‑time situational analysis
Faced with an uncrossable river, robot uses a provided plank as input
Applies reasoning to construct a solution and successfully cross
Designed for a single specialized task, e.g., AlphaGo mastering the game Go
Limited transferability; cannot perform unrelated tasks such as chess
Hypothetical self‑aware systems capable of reasoning and emotions
Often depicted in fiction, e.g., Ultron from the Avengers
Alexa responds only to intents it has been explicitly trained for
Fails to answer traffic queries when not pre‑programmed
User perception of multi‑task ability masks underlying narrow functionality
Each request triggers a specific programmed response rather than true understanding
Provides algorithms that learn from data and experience
Enables systems to improve performance without explicit programming
Subset of machine learning using neural‑network architectures inspired by the brain
Excels at extracting complex patterns from large datasets
Robots with legal citizenship, skeletal systems, and evolving emotions are being imagined
AI that understands or develops emotions could reshape human‑machine interaction
Unexplored AI domains present investment opportunities and ethical considerations
Future advancements may lead to human augmentation and new market paradigms
